title: Testing Out JPL's New Snake Robot (EELS, 2024)
contents: EELS snake robot crawling on snow, sand, an ice rink and down into a glacier moulin, made to explore icy moons like Enceladus. Captions are burned in (made for social media). 1080p, 2:05.
